occurrences.text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
